description: One server: status (refreshed while an operation is in progress), the last observed machine state (machineState), whether it is billed right now (a STOPPED server is still billed its full hourly rate; a HIBERNATED one its much lower hibernation rate), what keeping it hibernated costs (hibernation: CAD per hour and per month), OS image, public and private IPv4, SSH command, suspension, paid-until date, its 10 latest activity events (what happened, whether it worked, a short summary and an error code) and, when a stopped server may be deleted because the balance no longer pays it, deletionNotice (the time from which it may be deleted, hoursLeft, a message for the user, and the links to add balance and to turn the automatic reload on): show that message and those links to the user. (permission: servers:read) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
name: gpucloud_get_server
title: Get a server
